UPSTREAM: endian: Fix bebitenc() to actually encode big-endian bebitenc() just runs a downward loop over the same body as lebitenc(). That doesn't give you a byte-swapped result, it gives you the same final value, just starting from the other side to fill it in. (Also, it confused i++ and i--, so it really gives you a compiler error.) The correct code needs to have the array index inverted relative to the bit shift index to produce a big endian result. mkbp: Fix vup/vdn button code mixups MKBP driver seems to have two mixups with the vup/vdn button codes. 1. Button codes used for vup/vdn in enum Buttons does not match the codes used by vboot library. 2. button_scancodes array is expected to define codes in the same order as MKBP button event definitions. Because of the above two errors, we got lucky with vup/vdn usage i.e. when vup button was pressed, it used button_scancode for vdn from button_scancodes array and when this was reported back to vboot it used the wrong code i.e. code for vup. Two negatives ended up making a positive. This change fixes the button_scancodes index and the code value for vup and vdn. abstract_ssh.py: Fix wait_down() always waiting the full timeout Adds a max_ping_timeout parameter to wait_down() that limits the timeout on individual calls to get_boot_id(). The default is 10 seconds. Before, each ping of get_boot_id() had a timeout of (full timeout) - (time already waited), which means that it always waited for the full timeout in case the host went down, no matter when the host actually went down. As a result, this should significantly reduce the runtime of every autotest that reboots the machine. For instance, the runtime of enterprise_KioskEnrollmentServer, which calls ClearTPMOwnerRequest twice triggering two reboots, reduces from 4m20s to 3m20s. It reduces even further by another minute if the user presses CTRL+D to reboot the DUT instead of waiting 30 seconds for automatic reboot. BUG=None TEST=test_that -b <dut_board> <dut_ip> enterprise_KioskEnrollmentServer Change-Id: I7ead630c44348e9ffad96597ce971fcbb3b8c1f2 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/741704 Commit-Ready: Lutz Justen <ljusten@chromium.org> Tested-by: Lutz Justen <ljusten@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Lutz Justen <ljusten@chromium.org>
